summary: Full end-to-end test of Kompas MVP. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed (chat, conversations CRUD, narrative, assessment-results CRUD). Frontend (mobile 390x844): chat empty state, chat send, sidebar, zelftesten index (24 cards), category filter, PHQ-9 intro → 9 questions → result with AI narrative, crisis sheet with 'Bel 1813', settings with theme switching and persistence — all working. Belgian Dutch tone confirmed in Claude Sonnet 4.5 replies.

minor.issue: Conversation history is injected as text prefix because LlmChat session_id is not server-persisted; works but uses extra tokens. Currently functions correctly, follow-up context preserved.
`logger` is referenced inside chat() (line 268) but defined at module bottom (line 428). Works at runtime due to Python's late binding, but cleaner to move logger init above route handlers.

issues: Category chip row appears clipped/cut off vertically at the bottom edge of the chip pill (text 'Stemming/Angst/ADHD' has a faint cropping artifact in screenshot). Minor visual — readable, but the chip row could use 2px more vertical padding.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking but should be migrated in some component (likely a touchable wrapper).

action_items: (Optional polish) Increase vertical padding of category chip strip on /zelftesten so the pill text isn't cropped at the baseline.
(Optional polish) Replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop with `style.pointerEvents` to silence the React Native Web warning.
(Optional refactor) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` and `logging.basicConfig` to the top of server.py (above route handlers) for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses Python late-binding for `logger` referenced inside route handler before its module-level definition — works but unusual.

Chat history is replayed by concatenating into the prompt (last 12 messages). This is acceptable for MVP but will become token-expensive on long conversations; consider a summarization strategy when len(history) > 30.
seed_data_creation: Created several test conversations via /api/chat and a TEST_ assessment-result for PHQ-9 during pytest. These persist in MongoDB kompas_db.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend env var key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Use mobile viewport 390x844. All key testIDs follow the pattern: chat-* (chat screen), sidebar-* (sidebar), category-chip-{slug}, test-card-{id}, test-start, test-question, option-{0..n}, result-crisis-cta, crisis-sheet, crisis-call-1813, settings-theme-{night|klaar|system}. AI calls take 3-9s, allow generous timeouts (>=30s for chat, >=15s for narrative).
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA — all primary flows passed. Minor visual chip-crop on /zelftesten appears to be a paddingVertical issue in the FlatList horizontal chip row container in /app/frontend/app/zelftesten/index.tsx.
